q: A Turing machine's computation, viewed as a dynamical system, halts when its orbit:
opts: Reaches a halting state (configuration in Q_H × Γ^ℤ × ℤ)
exp: The Turing machine's step map δ* iterates configurations. Halting = the orbit reaches Q_H (the set of halting states). The halting problem asks whether this happens in finite steps — an undecidable property of the initial configuration.
